title: Neogen® Committed to Helping Ranchers, Livestock Producers, and Horse Owners Fight Against New World Screwworm
summary: Company expands availability of FIFRA 2(ee) recommendations to counter threat Neogen Corporation (NASDAQ: NEOG), an innovative leader in food and animal safety solutions, today announced the expanded availability of FIFRA* Section 2(ee) recommendations for the use of Prozap® Insectrin X Concentrate and Prozap® Screw Worm and Ear Tick Aerosol as part of New World Screwworm (NWS) response efforts. These recommendations provide ranchers, livestock producers, and horse owners with an additional option to support fly management efforts. In Texas, the Texas Department of Agriculture has approved Section 2(ee) recommendations for these products. Neogen is also making Section 2(ee) recommendations available in Florida, providing producers in both states with additional tools to incorporate into broader fly management programs.
